title: Etale-to-proetale comparison of the canonical direct-image projection morphism
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite discrete commutative ring and $p:X\to Y$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes. Work on small representatives of the etale and pro-etale sites in a common universe with ordinary uncompleted constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $F_T=\nu_T^*$, $u=p_{\mathrm{et}}^*$, $v=p_{\mathrm{proet}}^*$, $R_e=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}$ and $R_p=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}$. Use the canonical pullback comparison $a:F_Xu\xrightarrow{\sim}vF_Y$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], the tensor comparisons $t_T:F_T(B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}C)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_TB\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}F_TC$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and the normalized direct-image mate $b_B:F_YR_eB\xrightarrow{\sim}R_pF_XB$ for $B\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate].

Let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $N\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and assume $L=K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}uN$ also lies in $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Let $\pi_e$ and $\pi_p$ denote the canonical projection morphisms at $(K,N)$ and $(F_XK,F_YN)$, respectively: each is the adjoint transpose of the pullback tensor comparison followed by counit tensor identity [def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Set $h=(1\otimes a_N)\circ t_{X;K,uN}$. Then, as maps from $F_Y(R_eK\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N)$ to $R_p(F_XK\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}vF_YN)$,
$$R_p(h)\circ b_L\circ F_Y(\pi_e)=\pi_p\circ(b_K\otimes1)\circ t_{Y;R_eK,N}.$$
The equality is natural in the displayed inputs. Properness, constructibility, finite Tor amplitude and invertibility of the projection morphisms are not assumed.
